format.note: two conferences of six: 10 matches inside the conference and 6 against the other conference. This is one of the season's two championships; the Apertura and Clausura are separate 12-club tournaments with separate tables and no points carried between them.

playoff.note: 2nd West v 3rd East and 2nd East v 3rd West, then single-match semi-finals (conference winners host) and a single-match final at the Estadio Rommel Fernández; extra time and penalties if level

notes: One Panamanian row in our list and it is a half-season tournament, so the Apertura is closed in both directions in the data. In reality one club is relegated per season on the Apertura + Clausura accumulated table and the Liga Prom Superfinal winner replaces it (tier 2 not modelled); that happens at the end of the Clausura, not inside the Apertura. 12 clubs, two conferences of six, 16 rounds and a six-team play-off are confirmed by the Apertura 2026 page. From 2026 the calendar moved back to the European pattern at CONCACAF's request, so the second-half tournament is the Apertura again; the 2025 Clausura was a transition tournament with no promotion or relegation, which is why the same 12 clubs started 2026-27. Round 12 of the Apertura was postponed by the October 2026 earthquake, so mid-season tables have unequal games played.
